reason: Three months free with nothing to install, so I'll put the QR codes on a few tables and see if my regulars actually use it. If by month three it isn't bringing people back, I cancel before I pay a tetri of the 59 GEL.
objection: A new startup - will it still exist in a year, and who owns my guest data? If they fold or sell, my guest list goes with them. And the payment partner's fee on top of every bill, I don't know how much that is yet, and half my customers pay at the counter anyway.
would_change_my_mind: If the per-transaction fee turns out higher than my card terminal's, or they won't put in writing that I can export my guest list, I won't move to the paid plan.
